final_cross_split.limitation: Sentence lineage independence only; no Wikipedia article IDs supplied; lexical checks do not prove semantic independence.

pool_grouping.algorithm: Global-frequency ordered prefix-filter candidates followed by exact 5-gram Jaccard; union sentence pairs, exact sides and >=0.50 near sides before split assignment. Tightened once after an initial 0.80 audit found cross-split similarity 0.555556.
